name: issue-triage
description: Use this skill when asked to categorise, prioritise, or triage issues or feedback items.
---

# Issue triage

Follow these steps for each issue:

1. Read the title and body.
2. Classify it as exactly one of: Bug, Request, Question.
3. Assign a priority: High, Medium, or Low.
4. Give a one-sentence reason for the priority.
5. Output a table with columns: Issue, Category, Priority, Reason.

Never close, edit, or delete issues. Only recommend.
